  # softwares environment summary

editor_options:

```{r knitr_opts, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

) # continue running report even after chunk errors

report_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(knitr::current_input()))
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = report_dir,
  output.dir = report_dir
)
```
